dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular elliptical and circular light-intensity rings with jagged perimeters concentrated in the mid-lateral and posterior-lateral regions; edges show high-contrast transitions from dark surrounding pixels to lighter interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid, high-intensity white patches along the dorsal ridge, characterized by irregular borders and a lack of internal gradient or core darkening.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Identifiable triangular arrangement of centroids formed by three prominent annuli in the lower-mid section, supplemented by a linear progression of smaller ring centroids extending towards the posterior fluke region.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-contrast 'frosted' longitudinal banding extending along the primary dorsal curve, exhibiting a distinct mottled texture compared to lateral annuli.
